# Ashlr MD

> Open-source Markdown app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Agents install one command, call a CLI that prints JSON, and drive the live document over MCP.

This file is the agent manual. The same commands live in the README and in docs/EXAMPLES.md. The exhaustive per-tool notes live in docs/AGENTS.md. Tool order comes from `tool_registry()` in `src-tauri/bins/mdopener-mcp/src/lib.rs`.

## What it is

Ashlr MD renders Markdown on macOS, Windows, and Linux. `mdopen` opens a file in the app. `mdopener-mcp` is the MCP server agents launch over stdio. `open_file` is the only tool that starts the app. The server talks to the app on `127.0.0.1` with a token in `~/.mdopener/`.

People use the window to read, edit, and export. Agents use the CLI and the MCP tools.

## Install

macOS or Linux, from a checkout. Needs Rust, Bun, and git. This builds the CLI and the MCP server and skips the desktop app.

```bash
SKIP_APP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/install.sh
```

No checkout:

```bash
SKIP_APP_BUILD=1 bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/main/scripts/install.sh)
```

The script links `mdopen` and `mdopener-mcp` into `/usr/local/bin`, or into `~/.local/bin` when that directory is not writable. If the commands are missing:

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
```

When `claude` is on `PATH`, the script registers the MCP server. The desktop app is a release download: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Windows uses the NSIS installer, then the PowerShell commands in docs/EXAMPLES.md. The bash script is not the Windows install.

## JSON commands

These exit without reading MCP stdin. `doctor` and `setup --local` do not download a model and do not write config.

```bash
mdopener-mcp --version
mdopener-mcp doctor --json
mdopener-mcp doctor --fix --json
mdopener-mcp setup --local --json
mdopener-mcp --ashlr-handshake --json
mdopener-mcp --export-tool-schema
```

| Command | Output |
|---|---|
| `doctor --json` | one JSON object, `"kind": "ashlr.doctor"` |
| `doctor --fix --json` | one JSON object with `mode`, `plan`, and `outcome`. Dry run. Writes nothing |
| `doctor --fix --apply --json` | the same shape, and it makes the repairs |
| `setup --local --json` | one JSON object, `"kind": "ashlr.setup-local"`, `downloads` false, `writes` false |
| `--ashlr-handshake --json` | one JSON object, `"kind": "ashlr.handshake"` |
| `--export-tool-schema` | tool names and input schemas as JSON |

`mdopener-mcp doctor --apply` without `--fix` exits 2 and writes nothing. Repair rules: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/doctor-fix.md

## Connect MCP

```bash
claude mcp add --scope user ashlr-md "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
codex mcp add ashlr-md -- "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
python3 scripts/connect-cursor.py
```

Restart Claude Code after the first command. Codex picks the server up on its next run. The Cursor script merges `ashlr-md` into `~/.cursor/mcp.json` and writes nothing if that file is not JSON, if `mcpServers` is not an object, or if `ashlr-md` already points at a different program that still exists. Reload MCP in Cursor Settings.

In the desktop app: Preferences, AI agents (MCP), then Connect to Claude Code, Connect to Cursor, or Connect to Codex.

## Open a file

```bash
mdopen samples/agent-plan.md
mdopen --edit samples/agent-plan.md
```

`mdopen` exits 0 when a viewer accepted the file. The window requires the desktop app. The JSON commands above do not.

Deep link, when the app is installed:

```text
mdopener://open?path=/absolute/path/to/file.md
mdopener://open?path=/absolute/path/to/file.md&mode=edit
```

## Tools

`mdopener-mcp --export-tool-schema` is the source for arguments. Order in `tools/list`:

1. `open_file` starts the app. `path` is required. `mode` is `read` or `edit`.
2. `get_current_content` returns the open document. Error when none is open.
3. `list_recent` lists recent files. The app must already be running.
4. `request_review` blocks for a human verdict. Pass `path` or `content`.
5. `get_user_annotations` reads the latest verdict and task checkboxes. Works from disk when the app is closed.
6. `edit_document` replaces one exact `find` with `replace`. `save` defaults to false.
7. `search_vault` searches the watched folder and recents.
8. `present_document` switches the open doc to a distraction-free read view. It does not start the app.
9. `list_ai_actions` lists editor AI actions. No app required.
10. `get_conversation_context` reads a saved chat session.
11. `save_conversation_message` appends one message to that session.
12. `diff_documents` diffs two Markdown files on disk.
13. `stream_edit` previews a find/replace as a diff.
14. `stream_edit_apply` applies a preview.
15. `export_text` returns plain text with Markdown syntax stripped.
16. `export_metadata` returns headings, front matter, and wikilinks.
17. `edit_canvas` edits a `.canvas` file. It writes by default.
18. `export` exports the open document. Formats: `pdf`, `docx`, `html`, `epub`. The document must be in Read view. PDF takes no `output_path`.
19. `replace_document` replaces the whole open document.
20. `set_content` is the same whole-document replace.

Prefer `edit_document` over `set_content` and `replace_document`.

`open_file` arguments:

```json
{"path": "samples/agent-plan.md", "mode": "read"}
```

`edit_document` arguments. `find` must occur once:

```json
{"find": "## Phase 1: Core", "replace": "## Phase 1: Foundation", "path": "samples/agent-plan.md", "save": false}
```

`request_review` arguments:

```json
{"path": "samples/agent-plan.md", "blocking": true}
```

A blocking call returns `verdict` of `approved`, `changes_requested`, `dismissed`, `timeout`, or `superseded`, or `status` `pending` with a `reviewId` when the wait ends first. Call `request_review` again with that `review_id` to keep waiting.

`export` arguments. Call `open_file` with `"mode": "read"` first. HTML, DOCX, and EPUB can take `output_path` in an existing directory. PDF opens the system dialog.

```json
{"format": "html", "output_path": "/tmp/agent-plan.html", "overwrite": false}
```

Prompts you can hand an agent:

```text
Open samples/agent-plan.md in Ashlr MD with open_file, then show get_current_content.
```

```text
Call edit_document on the open document. find must match once. Then request_review and wait for my verdict.
```

## Local AI

Nothing is sent to a cloud model unless the person opts in.

- macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon: Apple Foundation Models, after Apple Intelligence is on. No API key.
- Other machines: Ollama, or a `localInference` block in `~/.ashlr/config.json`.
- `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` defaults to `https://api.anthropic.com`. `https://` to any host is accepted. Plain `http://` is accepted only for `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]`. Refusals send no request and do not repeat the value.
- `OLLAMA_HOST` for the app defaults to `http://localhost:11434`. A remote host needs `localInference.allowRemote: true` and `https://`. The environment cannot allow a remote host by itself.
- The MCP sidecar's default, when `OLLAMA_HOST` is unset, is `http://127.0.0.1:11434`. It refuses `http://localhost`.
- The default local model name is `qwen3.8:27b`. Names containing `abliterat` or `uncensored` are refused. No API key is sent to a `localInference` URL.
- `"offline": true` on that block refuses cloud calls, including through a loopback gateway.

Full rules: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/local-ai.md

```bash
mdopener-mcp doctor --json
mdopener-mcp setup --local --json
```

## Phantom

Phantom calls `mdopen` for `phm inbox show <id> --open` and `phm digest --open` when Ashlr MD is installed. The URL scheme is `mdopener://`. Under `phantom exec -- <cmd>`, keys arrive as `phm_` placeholders. Set `ASHLR_MD_ANTHROPIC_KEY_FROM_ENV=1` to read `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from the environment. A `phm_` placeholder is honored only when the base URL is the session proxy.

Contract: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/PHANTOM.md

## Security, short

The IPC server binds to `127.0.0.1`. The token file is `~/.mdopener/ipc-token`. Tools that take a path open Markdown documents that are not dotfiles. `mdopener-mcp doctor --fix` never changes `ipc-token`. Run `chmod 600 ~/.mdopener/ipc-token` yourself when doctor says to.

Threat model: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/SECURITY.md
